title: 수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00171:20151223:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 171, December 23, 2015>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on December 23, 2015.

Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes and Regulations)
The Enforcement Rules on Commemorative Events for Fishermen's Day are hereby repealed.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Emergency Preparedness Resources under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries shall be partially amended as follows:

In item (d) of subparagraph 1 of Article 2, "fishery products under Article 3, subparagraph 6 (b) of the Framework Act on Agriculture and Fisheries, Rural Community and Food Industry" shall be replaced with "fishery products under Article 3, subparagraph 7 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Fishing Villages Development."

(2) The Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 8 (4) 12, "Fishermen's Day" shall be replaced with "Fisheries Day."

Article 4 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where other statutes and regulations, including those promulgated before the enforcement of these Rules but not yet in force, cite the former Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on Agriculture and Fisheries, Rural Community and Food Industry or provisions thereof, and corresponding provisions exist in these Rules, such citations shall be deemed to refer to these Rules or the corresponding provisions thereof.
